desc:
👻 Investigate ghosts in haunted locations with your friends.  

🎃 Halloween event available until Nov 13! Explore the limited time Haunted Mansion map, and find trick or treat baskets around every map to earn extra candy and unlock new outfits and skins!
🏆 Ranked mode is back! Compete 1v1 against rival ghost hunters to reach the top ranks and earn special rewards at the end of the event.
🗺️ New map: Grief. Rework of Rural Home.

🔦 Use your equipment to find paranormal evidence and identify the ghost type, then escape before the ghost hunts you!
📖 Use hiding spots to your advantage, and carefully control your stamina to survive the hunt. If you need more help, read the journal's FAQ section during a match!

⚠️ This game contains flashing lights, loud noises, and scary scenes.
🎙️ The spirit box supports voice chat!
🎵 The lobby music and ambient soundtracks used in SPECTER are original and copyright free for use in videos!

Inspired by the horror game Phasmophobia.
